            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        本文主要介绍对象状态与操作合法性异常，主要包括四种：InvalidOperationException、ObjectDisposedException、NotSupportedException、NotImplementedException、PlatformNotSupportedException、TimeoutException。

<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2>〇、前言</h2>
<p>前文已经列举了全部有哪些常见的异常类型，本文继续介绍下各个类别的异常特点。</p>
<p>本文主要介绍对象状态与操作合法性异常，主要包括这几种：<strong>InvalidOperationException、ObjectDisposedException、NotSupportedException、NotImplementedException、PlatformNotSupportedException、TimeoutException</strong>。</p>
<p>点击链接可以查看本系列文章：<span style="font-size: 12px"><em><a title="https://www.cnblogs.com/hnzhengfy/category/2537680.html" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/hnzhengfy/category/2537680.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">C# Exception 详解系列</a>。</em></span></p>
<h2>一、参数校验类异常总览</h2>
<p><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>此类异常的共同点是：调用方的代码语法没错、参数也没错，错的是“时机”或“环境”。</strong></span>主要应对以下三个问题——<strong>对象还活着吗？对象现在处于允许该操作的状态吗？这个能力到底有没有？</strong> 选型的本质就是在这三者之间做区分。</p>
<table style="width: 89.7381%">
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="width: 25.1016%">异常类型</th>
<th style="width: 12.0935%">核心含义</th>
<th style="width: 15.0407%">永久性</th>
<th style="width: 20.935%">继承关系</th>
<th style="width: 10.5691%">重试有用？</th>
<th style="width: 16.3618%">首选替代</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="width: 25.1016%">InvalidOperationException</td>
<td style="width: 12.0935%">状态/时序不对</td>
<td style="width: 15.0407%">否（重排序可能成功）</td>
<td style="width: 20.935%"><code>Exception</code></td>
<td style="width: 10.5691%">看情况</td>
<td style="width: 16.3618%">拆接口、状态机</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="width: 25.1016%">ObjectDisposedException</td>
<td style="width: 12.0935%">已释放</td>
<td style="width: 15.0407%">是</td>
<td style="width: 20.935%"><code>InvalidOperationException</code></td>
<td style="width: 10.5691%">无用</td>
<td style="width: 16.3618%">生命周期治理</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="width: 25.1016%">NotSupportedException</td>
<td style="width: 12.0935%">设计上无此能力</td>
<td style="width: 15.0407%">是</td>
<td style="width: 20.935%"><code>Exception</code></td>
<td style="width: 10.5691%">无用</td>
<td style="width: 16.3618%">换窄接口 / CanXxx 探测</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="width: 25.1016%">NotImplementedException</td>
<td style="width: 12.0935%">还没写</td>
<td style="width: 15.0407%">否（将来会有）</td>
<td style="width: 20.935%"><code>Exception</code></td>
<td style="width: 10.5691%">无用</td>
<td style="width: 16.3618%">补全实现</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="width: 25.1016%">PlatformNotSupportedException</td>
<td style="width: 12.0935%">当前平台无此能力</td>
<td style="width: 15.0407%">是（换机器才行）</td>
<td style="width: 20.935%"><code>NotSupportedException</code></td>
<td style="width: 10.5691%">无用</td>
<td style="width: 16.3618%">运行时平台分支降级</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="width: 25.1016%">TimeoutException</td>
<td style="width: 12.0935%">等超时了</td>
<td style="width: 15.0407%">否（重试可能成功）</td>
<td style="width: 20.935%"><code>Exception</code></td>
<td style="width: 10.5691%">谨慎（幂等性）</td>
<td style="width: 16.3618%"><code>CancellationToken</code></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i170.39f229880nF1uR">最容易选错的三对：</span></strong></div>
<ol class="qk-md-ol" start="1">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><code class="qk-md-code">ArgumentException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;vs&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">InvalidOperationException</code></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：前者是“你传的东西不对”，后者是“东西对，但现在不能做”。判断标准：同样的参数换个时机能不能成功？能 → InvalidOperation。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><code class="qk-md-code">NotSupportedException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;vs&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">NotImplementedException</code></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：设计问题 vs 进度问题。选反了调用方会做出错误决策（比如绕开你这个实现，或者傻傻等你发版）。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><code class="qk-md-code">TimeoutException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;vs&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">OperationCanceledException</code></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：同步/协议超时 vs 异步取消。前者在&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">System.Runtime</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">，后者在&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">System.Threading</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">，连命名空间都不一样。</span></li>
</ol>
<p><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">关键记忆点：ObjectDisposedException 继承自 InvalidOperationException；PlatformNotSupportedException 继承自 NotSupportedException。所以 catch 基类时会“顺带”捕获子类，顺序写反就会吞掉更精确的信息。</span></strong></span></p>
<p><span class="qk-md-text complete">以下是几条通用纪律，需要注意。</span></p>
<ol class="qk-md-ol" start="1">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">带上上下文</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：message 里写清“当前状态 / 期望状态 / 哪个对象 / 哪个平台 / 超时多少毫秒”。这些异常在线上通常意味着流程缺陷，光看类型不够定位。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">XML 文档标注</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：</span><code class="qk-md-code">/// &lt;exception cref="..."&gt;</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">，让调用方在 IDE 里就能看到前置条件。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">能用布尔/枚举/接口表达的，不要用异常</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：</span><code class="qk-md-code">TryOpen()</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">、</span><code class="qk-md-code">CanWrite</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">、</span><code class="qk-md-code">IReadOnlyList&lt;T&gt;</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;都优于“调了再 catch”。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">不要在 hot path 上用它们做控制流</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：</span><code class="qk-md-code">foreach</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;里靠 catch&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">NotSupportedException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;判断能否写入，性能会很难看。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">catch 顺序从细到粗</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：先&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">ObjectDisposedException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;再&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">InvalidOperationException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">；先&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">PlatformNotSupportedException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;再&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">NotSupportedException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i173.39f229880nF1uR"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">自定义异常要克制</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：这六种已经覆盖了 99% 的状态类错误。<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)">只有当“调用方需要单独 catch 并做特殊恢复”时，才值得派生自己的异常</span>（并记得设 HResult 与 Serializable）。</span></li>
</ol>
<h2>二、各个异常简介与简单示例</h2>
<h3>2.1 InvalidOperationException —— “现在不行”</h3>
<p class="qk-md-head"><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i111.39f229880nF1uR">语义：</span><strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">对象处于某个</span><span class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i102.39f229880nF1uR">合法但不适合本次操作</span></span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete"><strong>的状态</strong>。它不是永久的否定（换个时序就能成功），也不是参数错误。这是本组里最常用、也最容易被滥用的一类。</span></span></p>
<p class="qk-md-head" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i101.39f229880nF1uR"><span class="qk-md-text complete">典型 BCL 案例：</span></p>
<ul class="qk-md-ul">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><code class="qk-md-code">SqlConnection</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;未&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">Open()</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;就执行&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">ExecuteReader</code></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i103.39f229880nF1uR"><code class="qk-md-code">IEnumerator.MoveNext()</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;时发现集合被修改（内部靠 version 计数器检测），抛&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">InvalidOperationException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">：“Collection was modified; enumeration operation may not execute.”</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><code class="qk-md-code">List&lt;T&gt;.Remove()</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;在只读包装上</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">LINQ 的&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">Single()</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;/&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">First()</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;在空序列上；</span><code class="qk-md-code">Enumerable.Cast&lt;T&gt;()</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;转型失败</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">在&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">foreach</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;进行中修改集合；</span><code class="qk-md-code">DataTable</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;在 BeginLoadData 期间写入</span></li>
</ul>
<pre class="language-csharp highlighter-hljs"><code>// 一个简单的示例：
public class OrderProcessor
{
    private enum State { Created, Started, Completed }
    private State _state = State.Created;
    private readonly List&lt;string&gt; _items = new();
    
    public void Start()
    {
        if (_state != State.Created)
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                $"Order cannot be started in {_state} state.");
        _state = State.Started;
    }
    public void AddItem(string item)
    {
        if (_state == State.Completed)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Order already completed.");
        _items.Add(item);
    }
    public IEnumerable&lt;string&gt; GetItems()
    {
        foreach (var it in _items)   // 调用方若在此期间修改 _items，MoveNext 会抛 InvalidOperationException
            yield return it;
    }
}</code></pre>
<p class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i113.39f229880nF1uR">适用场景：</span></p>
<ul class="qk-md-ul">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">有明确</span><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">状态机</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">的对象（连接、事务、订单、任务、流）</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">需要先调用 Init/Open/BeginXxx 的资源型对象</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">枚举器、迭代器、延迟执行（</span><code class="qk-md-code">yield</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;/ LINQ）的合法性校验</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">多线程下“已被别人先做完”的竞态（配合&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">Interlocked</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;判断）</span></li>
</ul>
<p class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete">常见误用：</span></p>
<ol class="qk-md-ol" start="1">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">把参数错包成它</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：</span><code class="qk-md-code">index</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;越界应抛&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">ArgumentOutOfRangeException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">，不是 InvalidOperation。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">用它掩盖设计缺陷</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：如果某方法“常常不能调用”，说明接口太胖，应拆成&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">ICanStart</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;/&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">IStartable</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;等小接口，让不支持的状态在编译期就不可见。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">消息里不带状态信息</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">。好的 message 要写明“当前是什么状态、期望什么状态”，便于线上排查。</span></li>
</ol>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>2.2 ObjectDisposedException —— “已经死了”</h3>
<p class="qk-md-head"><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i117.39f229880nF1uR">语义：</span><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i116.39f229880nF1uR"><strong>对象的生命周期已结束</strong>，任何成员（除再次&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">Dispose</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;外）都不应被调用。它是&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">InvalidOperationException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;的子类，但语义更窄、更可诊断。</span></span></p>
<p class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete">需要特别注意的地方：</span></p>
<ul class="qk-md-ul">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><code class="qk-md-code">Dispose</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;必须幂等</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">，第二次调用不该抛异常；抛的是“其他成员在 Dispose 之后被调用”。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">标准做法是在每个公开成员开头做 disposed 检查；字段&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">_disposed</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;建议用&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">bool</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">（简单场景）或结合&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">GC.SuppressFinalize</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong><span class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">.NET 7+</span></span><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;提供了&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(bool condition, object instance)</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">，一行搞定且消息格式统一。</span></strong></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">不要从终结器（finalizer）里抛；也不要指望托管对象在终结阶段仍可用。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">异步场景注意：</span><code class="qk-md-code">DisposeAsync</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;后仍有 await 在跑，属于典型的“已释放仍使用”。</span></strong></li>
</ul>
<pre class="language-csharp highlighter-hljs"><code>public sealed class LogWriter : IDisposable
{
    private readonly StreamWriter _writer;
    private bool _disposed;

    public LogWriter(string path) =&gt; _writer = new StreamWriter(path, append: true);

    public void Write(string message)
    {
        // .NET 7+ 推荐写法：ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(_disposed, this);
        if (_disposed) throw new ObjectDisposedException(nameof(LogWriter));

        _writer.WriteLine($"{DateTime.Now:O} {message}");
    }
    public void Flush()
    {
        if (_disposed) throw new ObjectDisposedException(nameof(LogWriter));
        _writer.Flush();
    }
    public void Dispose()
    {
        if (_disposed) return;     // 幂等
        _writer.Dispose();         // 释放资源
        _disposed = true;          // 标志置位必须在释放之后（避免释放失败时误判为已释放）
    }
}

// 调用方
var log = new LogWriter("app.log");
log.Dispose();
log.Write("oops");   // ObjectDisposedException: Cannot access a disposed object. Object name: 'LogWriter'.</code></pre>
<p class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i119.39f229880nF1uR">适用场景：</span></p>
<ul class="qk-md-ul">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">所有实现&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">IDisposable</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;/&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">IAsyncDisposable</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;的类型（流、连接、句柄包装、缓存文件、定时器）</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">池化对象归还后再使用</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">HttpClient 被 Dispose 后复用（非常常见的线上 bug）</span></li>
</ul>
<p class="qk-md-head"><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><span class="qk-md-text complete">与 InvalidOperationException 的取舍。</span><span class="qk-md-text complete">若类型没有实现&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">IDisposable</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">，就用&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">InvalidOperationException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">。</span></span><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">ObjectDisposedException 是 Dispose 模式的专属信号</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">，监控告警和日志检索时它能直接指向生命周期管理问题，因此值得单独使用。</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>2.3 NotSupportedException —— “设计上就没有”</h3>
<p class="qk-md-head"><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i122.39f229880nF1uR">语义：</span><span class="qk-md-text complete">成员存在于接口/基类契约中，但</span><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">当前实现从设计上就无法提供</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">。这不是临时状态，重试一万次也一样。</span></span></p>
<p class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete">典型 BCL 案例：</span></p>
<ul class="qk-md-ul">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><code class="qk-md-code">Stream</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;只读时&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">CanWrite == false</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">，调用&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">Write</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;→&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">NotSupportedException</code></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><code class="qk-md-code">Array</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;/ 固定大小列表实现&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">IList.Add</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;→&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">NotSupportedException</code></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><code class="qk-md-code">ReadOnlyCollection&lt;T&gt;.Add</code></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><code class="qk-md-code">Encoding.GetEncoding("unsupported")</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;的部分场景（更多是 ArgumentException）</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><code class="qk-md-code">ICollection&lt;T&gt;.IsReadOnly == true</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;时的修改方法</span></li>
</ul>
<pre class="language-csharp highlighter-hljs"><code>public class ReadOnlyStream : Stream
{
    private readonly Stream _inner;
    public ReadOnlyStream(Stream inner) =&gt; _inner = inner;

    public override bool CanRead =&gt; true;
    public override bool CanWrite =&gt; false;   // 关键：先提供探测属性
    public override bool CanSeek =&gt; _inner.CanSeek;

    public override long Length =&gt; _inner.Length;
    public override long Position { get =&gt; _inner.Position; set =&gt; throw new NotSupportedException(); }

    public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count) =&gt; _inner.Read(buffer, offset, count);

    public override void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count) =&gt;
        throw new NotSupportedException("This stream is read-only.");

    public override void Flush() { }
    public override long Seek(long offset, SeekOrigin origin) =&gt; _inner.Seek(offset, origin);
    public override void SetLength(long value) =&gt; throw new NotSupportedException();
}</code></pre>
<p class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i126.39f229880nF1uR">适用场景：</span></p>
<ul class="qk-md-ul">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">实现“宽接口”（</span><code class="qk-md-code">IList</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">、</span><code class="qk-md-code">IDbCommand</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">、</span><code class="qk-md-code">Stream</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">、</span><code class="qk-md-code">ICollection</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">）的子集能力时</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">适配器/装饰器模式中底层能力缺失</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">抽象基类中某些操作对部分子类无意义</span></li>
</ul>
<p class="qk-md-head"><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">最佳实践：能探测就别让调用方靠异常编程。</span></strong></span><span class="qk-md-text complete">BCL 的标准模式是&nbsp;</span><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">CanXxx 属性 + 抛异常</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">双保险：</span></p>
<pre class="language-csharp highlighter-hljs"><code>// 推荐：先问，再做
if (stream.CanWrite)
    stream.Write(buf, 0, len);

// 不推荐：做了再说，靠异常当分支
try { stream.Write(buf, 0, len); }
catch (NotSupportedException) { /* 哦，原来不能写 */ }</code></pre>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">文档里要明确写清“哪些成员会抛”，并在 XML 注释中标注&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">&lt;exception cref="NotSupportedException"&gt;</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">。</span></div>
<p class="qk-md-head"><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><span class="qk-md-text complete">设计层面的反思。</span><span class="qk-md-text complete">如果发现自己经常为 </span><code class="qk-md-code">Add</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">/</span><code class="qk-md-code">Remove</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;抛&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">NotSupportedException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">，优先考虑</span><span class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">换接口</span></span><span class="qk-md-text complete">：用&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">IReadOnlyList&lt;T&gt;</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;代替&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">IList&lt;T&gt;</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">，用&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">IEnumerable&lt;T&gt;</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;代替&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">ICollection&lt;T&gt;</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">。让编译期和 IDE 提示阻止非法调用，比运行时抛异常好一个数量级。</span></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>2.4 NotImplementedException —— “还没做”</h3>
<p class="qk-md-head"><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i131.39f229880nF1uR">语义：</span><span class="qk-md-text complete">代码路径</span><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">暂时不存在</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">，属于开发期占位。它与“不支持”的区别在于意图：<strong>将来会有，只是现在没有</strong>。</span></span></p>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">HResult 是&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">0x80004001 (E_NOTIMPL)</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">，而&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">NotSupportedException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;是&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">0x80131515</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">——调试器里一眼可分。</span></div>
<pre class="language-csharp highlighter-hljs"><code>public class PaymentService : IPaymentService
{
    public Task PayAsync(decimal amount) =&gt; throw new NotImplementedException("微信支付尚未接入，预计 Q4 完成");

    // IDE 自动生成接口实现时默认就填这个，方便你逐个实现
    public Task RefundAsync(string id) =&gt; throw new NotImplementedException();
}</code></pre>
<p class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i134.39f229880nF1uR">适用场景：</span></p>
<ul class="qk-md-ul">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">IDE 生成接口/重写方法后的<strong>占位</strong>（这是它最主要、最正当的用途）</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">大功能分迭代交付时，先让项目编译通过</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">极少见的情况：基类提供可选钩子，子类无需覆盖时（此时更推荐&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">virtual</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;空实现或抽象类）</span></li>
</ul>
<p class="qk-md-head" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i133.39f229880nF1uR"><span class="qk-md-text complete">不该用的地方：</span></p>
<ul class="qk-md-ul">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">永远不该出现在生产代码的正常运行路径上</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">。上线前必须清零，否则用户会看到一个比&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">NotSupportedException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;更难理解的错误。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">不要拿它表达“这个子类永远不会有此能力”——那是&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">NotSupportedException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">不要拿它表达“参数组合还没处理”——那是&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">ArgumentException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;或&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">InvalidOperationException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">。</span></li>
</ul>
<p>记忆口诀：<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>NotImplemented = 时间问题；NotSupportedException = 设计问题</strong></span>。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>2.5 PlatformNotSupportedException —— “这台机器跑不了”</h3>
<p><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>语义：API 编译进去了（通常是共享代码库 / multi-targeting），但当前 OS 或运行时无法提供底层能力</strong>。它是 <code>NotSupportedException </code>的子类，因此 catch 父类时会被一并捕获——catch 顺序要注意。</span></p>
<p class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete">典型 BCL 案例：</span></p>
<ul class="qk-md-ul">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><code class="qk-md-code">Microsoft.Win32.Registry</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;在非 Windows 平台</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><code class="qk-md-code">ProcessStartInfo.Verb = "runas"</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">（提权）在非 Windows</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><code class="qk-md-code">WindowsIdentity</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;/&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">WindowsPrincipal</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;在 Linux</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><code class="qk-md-code">Console.Beep()</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;在部分 Unix 终端</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><code class="qk-md-code">Rfc2898DeriveBytes</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;的某些硬件加速路径、</span><code class="qk-md-code">Vector</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;硬件内在指令在不支持的 CPU</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">MAUI / Blazor Hybrid 中调用桌面专属 API</span></li>
</ul>
<pre class="language-csharp highlighter-hljs"><code>using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

public static class OsHelper
{
    public static void SetRegistryValue(string key, string value)
    {
        if (!RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Windows))
            throw new PlatformNotSupportedException(
                "Registry is only available on Windows. Use a config file on Linux/macOS.");

        Microsoft.Win32.Registry.CurrentUser.CreateSubKey(key).SetValue("App", value);
    }

    // 更好的做法：主动降级而不是抛
    public static string GetConfigPath() =&gt;
        RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Windows)
            ? Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.ApplicationData), "app.cfg")
            : Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.UserProfile), ".app.cfg");
}</code></pre>
<p class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i142.39f229880nF1uR">适用场景：</span></p>
<ul class="qk-md-ul">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">多目标框架（netstandard / net8.0 + windows）的共享库</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">容器化/跨平台迁移时保留旧 Windows 专属 API 的桩</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">条件编译（</span><code class="qk-md-code">#if WINDOWS</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">）之外的运行时分支</span></li>
</ul>
<p class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete">最佳实践：</span></p>
<ol class="qk-md-ol" start="1">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">优先用&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;/&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">OperatingSystem.IsWindows()</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;做主动分支</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">，优雅降级或返回替代方案，别让用户跑到深处才撞异常。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">消息里写明“哪个平台支持、当前平台有什么替代手段”。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">单元测试要用&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">[Fact(Skip = ...)]</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;或&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">OperatingSystem</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;守卫，避免 CI 在 Linux 上跑 Windows 用例全红。</span></li>
</ol>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>2.6 TimeoutException —— “等太久了”</h3>
<p class="qk-md-head"><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><span class="qk-md-text complete">语义：</span><span class="qk-md-text complete">操作在约定时间内未完成。</span></span></p>
<p class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete">注意：<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)">它表示</span></span><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">等待策略耗尽</span></strong></span><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i146.39f229880nF1uR"><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)">，不代表对方失败、也不代表操作没发生</span>（可能已经在执行，重复重试会造成双重扣款之类的问题）。</span></p>
<pre class="language-csharp highlighter-hljs"><code>public async Task&lt;string&gt; FetchWithTimeoutAsync(HttpClient client, Uri uri, TimeSpan timeout)
{
    using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource(timeout);
    try
    {
        return await client.GetStringAsync(uri, cts.Token);
    }
    catch (OperationCanceledException) when (!cts.Token.IsCancellationRequested)
    {
        // HttpClient 超时会抛出 TaskCanceledException（派生自 OperationCanceledException）
        throw new TimeoutException($"GET {uri} timed out after {timeout.TotalSeconds}s.");
    }
}

// 同步/协议级超时：串口、WCF、自定义握手
public byte[] ReadExactly(SerialPort port, int count, int millisecondsTimeout)
{
    var buf = new byte[count];
    var end = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMilliseconds(millisecondsTimeout);
    int read = 0;
    while (read &lt; count)
    {
        if (DateTime.UtcNow &gt; end)
            throw new TimeoutException($"Expected {count} bytes, got {read}.");
        port.ReadTimeout = Math.Max(1, (int)(end - DateTime.UtcNow).TotalMilliseconds);
        read += port.Read(buf, read, count - read);
    }
    return buf;
}</code></pre>
<p class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i149.39f229880nF1uR">适用场景：</span></p>
<ul class="qk-md-ul">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">同步阻塞式 IO、串口/套接字读写、协议握手</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">分布式锁 / 信号量等待超时（</span><code class="qk-md-code">SemaphoreSlim.Wait(timeout)</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;返回 false 时可转抛）</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">外部系统调用的客户端封装（把底层的&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">TaskCanceledException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;统一翻译成业务可读的&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">TimeoutException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">）</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">缓存击穿防护中的“取不到就别等”</span></li>
</ul>
<p class="qk-md-head"><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">重要陷阱：TPL / 异步取消不用它：</span></strong></span></p>
<ul class="qk-md-ul">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><code class="qk-md-code">CancellationToken</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;超时 → 抛&nbsp;</span><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><code class="qk-md-code">OperationCanceledException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;/&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">TaskCanceledException</code></strong></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><code class="qk-md-code">HttpClient</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;超时 →&nbsp;</span><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><code class="qk-md-code">TaskCanceledException</code></strong></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><code class="qk-md-code">Task.Wait/Result</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;超时 → 返回 false 或包在&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">AggregateException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;里</span></li>
</ul>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">也就是说：</span><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><code class="qk-md-code">TimeoutException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;是“协议/同步等待”的语言，</span><code class="qk-md-code">OperationCanceledException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;是“异步取消”的语言</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">。混用会让 catch 逻辑全部失效。另外，捕获&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">TimeoutException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;后重试一定要问自己：上游是不是已经生效了？（幂等性 / 补偿机制）</span></div>
<h2>三、把以上异常放在一个真实场景里对照</h2>
<p>下面是一个假想的“消息发送器”，四类异常各司其职：</p>
<pre class="language-csharp highlighter-hljs"><code>public class SmtpSender : IDisposable
{
    private bool _disposed;
    private bool _connected;
    private readonly int _timeoutMs;

    public SmtpSender(int timeoutMs = 5000) =&gt; _timeoutMs = timeoutMs;

    public void Connect()
    {
        ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(_disposed, this);
        if (_connected) throw new InvalidOperationException("Already connected.");
        // ... 真正连
        _connected = true;
    }

    public void Send(string to, string body)
    {
        ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(_disposed, this);
        if (!_connected) throw new InvalidOperationException("Send requires Connect() first.");
        // ... 发送，带超时        
        // 组合：调用方超时 + 本类默认超时
        using var linkedCts = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(cancellationToken);
        linkedCts.CancelAfter(_timeoutMs);
        try
        {
            await _client.SendMailAsync(to, body, linkedCts.Token);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException ex) when (!cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            // 是自己的超时触发的 → 转成业务可读的 TimeoutException
            throw new TimeoutException($"Send timed out after {_timeoutMs}ms.", ex);
        }
        // 调用方主动取消：原样抛出 OperationCanceledException，不要包成 TimeoutException
    }

    // 这个实现只会发文本，附件从设计上就不支持
    public virtual void SendWithAttachment(string to, string body, string path) =&gt;
        throw new NotSupportedException("Attachments are not supported by this sender.");

    // 下个迭代才接的模板功能
    public void SendTemplate(string templateId, object model) =&gt;
        throw new NotImplementedException("Template sending planned for v2.");

    // 只在 Windows 上可用的 SSO 登录
    public void LoginWithCurrentUser()
    {
        if (!OperatingSystem.IsWindows())
            throw new PlatformNotSupportedException("SSPI login requires Windows.");
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        if (_disposed) return;
        _connected = false;
        _disposed = true;
    }
}</code></pre>
<p>同一个类里五种异常各归其位，调用方靠类型就能判断“我该重连、该换实现、该升级版本、还是该换操作系统”。</p>
<h2>四、小小的总结</h2>
<p><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>这六种异常处理的都是“参数没错，但调用依然失败”的情况，核心在于区分失败的原因究竟是对象还活着、能力是否存在还是时机对不对。</strong></span></p>
<p>按性质可分为三组：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>生命周期问题只有 ObjectDisposedException</strong>，表示对象已释放且不可恢复，前提是类型实现了 IDisposable，否则应退回 InvalidOperationException；</li>
<li>能力问题包含 NotSupportedException（设计上就不支持）、NotImplementedException（暂时没写完，上线前应清零）以及 PlatformNotSupportedException（当前平台不支持），三者均属永久性失败，重试毫无意义；</li>
<li>时序与环境问题则是 InvalidOperationException（状态或顺序不对，换个时机可能成功）和 TimeoutException（等待策略耗尽，不等于操作未发生）。</li>
</ol>
<p><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>选型时依次自问：对象释放了吗？能力是设计上没有、还没写，还是平台不支持？状态不对吗？等太久了吗？</strong></span>每个答案对应不同的修复方向：治理生命周期、收窄接口或补全实现、修正调用时序、改进超时与取消策略。</p>
<p>需要留意三个易错点：<span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>ArgumentException 与 InvalidOperationException 的区别在于同样参数换个时机能否成功；后两者属于设计问题与进度问题，选反会误导调用方；同步超时用 TimeoutException，异步取消则走 OperationCanceledException，混用会导致 catch 逻辑失效。</strong></span>此外，继承关系决定了 catch 顺序必须从细到粗，先捕获子类再捕获父类。</p>

</div>
